source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 3 (PDF 51-93), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 3 (Cells and Subcellular Organelles) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.
3.1 Cells: the basic unit of life

blocks.prompt:
1 Name the seven basic properties of life shown by all living organisms.
(Tamam jandaaron mein paayi jaane wali zindagi ki saat bunyadi properties ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Movement (harkat), respiration (tanaffus), homeostasis (andar ka tawazun), growth (barhna), reproduction (nasal kashi), excretion (fuzla kharij karna) aur nutrition (ghiza). Cells yeh tamam bunyadi kaam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: These properties actually define living organisms

blocks.prompt:
2 How do cells show the property of movement? Give two examples.
(Cells harkat ki property kaise dikhate hain? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Cells harkat kar sakte hain: sperm cells flagella se chalte hain aur white blood cells infection se larne ke liye khoon mein safar karte hain. Cell ke andar organelles bhi harkat karte hain.

book_ref.quote: White blood cells travel through the bloodstream to fight infections

blocks.prompt:
3 Differentiate between the roles of mitosis and meiosis in cell reproduction.
(Cell reproduction mein mitosis aur meiosis ke kirdaar mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono cells ki reproduction ke tareeqe hain:

book_ref.quote: Mitosis produces identical daughter cells for growth and repair

rows: Aik jaise daughter cells banata hai
Gametes banata hai
Growth aur marammat ke liye
Sexual reproduction ke liye

blocks.prompt:
4 What did Robert Hooke observe in 1665, and what name did he give to his observation?
(Robert Hooke ne 1665 mein kya dekha aur us ka kya naam rakha?)
blocks.explanation: Hooke ne oak darakht ke cork (aur tanay aur jar ke tukron) ko microscope mein dekha to woh "many little boxes" se bane the. Us ne kaha ke paudon ke hisse khaanon se bane hain aur unhein "cellulae" ka naam diya.

book_ref.quote: He concluded that the parts of plants were made of compartments

blocks.prompt:
5 What were the contributions of Schleiden and Schwann to the cell theory?
(Cell theory mein Schleiden aur Schwann ka kya hissa tha?)
blocks.explanation: 1838 mein German botanist Matthias Schleiden ne kaha ke tamam paude cells se bane hain. Agle saal German zoologist Theodor Schwann ne yahi baat janwaron ke liye kahi.

book_ref.quote: After these studies, biologists began to organize information about cells

blocks.prompt:
6 Who gave the idea that all cells come from other cells, and who proved it experimentally?
(Yeh khayal ke tamam cells doosre cells se aate hain kis ne diya, aur is ka tajurbati saboot kis ne diya?)
blocks.explanation: German physician Rudolf Virchow ne dekha ke tamam cells doosre cells se aate hain (yeh 1855 mein kaha gaya; kitaab ka 1885 ghalat chhapa hai). Louis Pasteur ne 1862 mein is ka tajurbati saboot diya.

book_ref.quote: These observations were combined to form a basic theory about cells

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitaab mein Virchow ka saal 1885 likha hai jo mumkin nahi, kyun ke Pasteur ka saboot 1862 ka hai. Sahi saal 1855 hai.

blocks.prompt:
7 Why have plasmodesmata caused debate among scientists regarding the cell theory?
(Plasmodesmata ne cell theory ke baare mein scientists mein behas kyun chhedi?)
blocks.explanation: Plasmodesmata saath wale plant cells ke cytoplasm ko seedha jorte hain. Is liye kuch scientists kehte hain ke unche paudon ke cells asal mein alag cells nahi kyun ke woh aik doosre se jismani tor par alag ya azad nahi.

book_ref.quote: Plasmodesmata have caused debate among scientists regarding cell theory

blocks.prompt:
8 How do certain fungi and algae blur the boundaries of individual cells?
(Kuch fungi aur algae alag alag cells ki hadood ko kaise dhundla kar dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch fungi aur algae mein aise dhaanche hain jin mein kayi nuclei aik hi mushtarka cytoplasm mein hote hain. Yeh riwayati cell theory ke mutabiq alag cells ki hadood ko dhundla kar dete hain.

book_ref.quote: have structures where multiple nuclei coexist within a shared cytoplasmic mass

blocks.prompt:
9 How do cell culture studies and tissue engineering validate the cell theory?
(Cell culture studies aur tissue engineering cell theory ki tasdeeq kaise karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh tajurbe cells ki growth, differentiation (mukhtalif qisam mein badalna) aur reproduction dikhate hain, jis se cell theory ki tasdeeq hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Experiments, such as cell culture studies and tissue engineering, validate cell theory

blocks.prompt:
10 Define magnification. How is the total magnification of a microscope determined?
(Magnification ki definition likhein. Microscope ki total magnification kaise maloom hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Magnification microscope ki object ki image bari karne ki salahiyat hai; ise 'X' se likhte hain (10X lens 1 µm cheez ko 10 µm dikhata hai). Total magnification tamam lenses ki magnification zarb kar ke milti hai.

book_ref.quote: For example, a 10X lens can enlarge a 1 µm object to 10 µm

blocks.prompt:
11 Define resolution. Give the resolution of the naked human eye and of a light microscope.
(Resolution ki definition likhein. Nangi aankh aur light microscope ki resolution batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Resolution qareeb qareeb do points ko alag pehchanne ki salahiyat hai; zyada resolution bareek tafseel dikhati hai. Nangi aankh taqreeban 0.1 mm aur light microscope taqreeban 250 nm tak alag dekh sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: The greater the resolution, the finer the detail that can be observed

blocks.prompt:
12 Why are stains used in light microscopy? What is their drawback?
(Light microscopy mein stains kyun lagaye jaate hain? In ka nuqsan kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cells aam tor par shaffaf hote hain, is liye un ke hisse tab tak nazar nahi aate jab tak unhein khaas stains (rangeen chemicals) se rang na diya jaye. Magar staining aksar cells ko maar deti hai.

book_ref.quote: their components are not distinguishable unless they are coloured with special stains

blocks.prompt:
13 Differentiate between TEM and SEM.
(TEM aur SEM mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono electron microscopes hain:

book_ref.quote: TEM transmits a beam of electrons through a very thin specimen

rows: Cell ki andar ki structure dekhne ke liye
Cells ya doosri cheezon ki satah ki tafseel ke liye
Electrons ki beam bohat patle specimen se guzarta hai
Satah par dhaat chadhai jaati hai; beam us se reflect ho kar image banati hai
250,000 guna tak bara karta hai
100,000 guna tak bara karta hai

blocks.prompt:
14 Differentiate between a light microscope and an electron microscope with respect to illuminating source, specimens and the way the image is seen.
(Light aur electron microscope mein roshni ke zariye, specimens aur image dekhne ke tareeqe ke lehaaz se farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Chapter ke farq wale table se:

book_ref.quote: Both live and dead specimens can be seen

rows: Light (taqreeban 400-700 nm) istemal karta hai
Electron beams istemal karta hai
Zinda aur murda dono specimen dekhe ja sakte hain
Sirf murda aur sukhaaye specimen
Specimen chand minute ya aik ghante mein tayyar
Specimen tayyar karne mein kayi din
Image ocular lens se dekhi jaati hai; screen ki zaroorat nahi
Image fluorescent screen par aati hai

blocks.prompt:
15 What is a cell wall? What is a protoplast?
(Cell wall kya hai? Protoplast kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cell wall cell ke gird aik kuch had tak thos tah hai jo bacteria, fungi, paudon aur algae mein hoti hai. Jab enzymes se cell wall hata di jaye to cell ka baqi hissa protoplast kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: Cell wall is a more or less solid layer surrounding a cell

blocks.prompt:
16 What is the middle lamella? What is it made of?
(Middle lamella kya hai? Yeh kis cheez se bani hai?)
blocks.explanation: Middle lamella aik jelly jaisi tah hai jo saath wale cells ki primary walls ko alag bhi karti aur jore bhi rakhti hai. Yeh cytokinesis mein cell plate se sab se pehle banti hai aur is mein magnesium aur calcium pectates (pectic acid ke namak) hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The middle lamella is a gelatinous layer that separates and holds the primary walls

blocks.prompt:
17 Differentiate between primary and secondary cell walls.
(Primary aur secondary cell wall mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono walls ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Secondary cell walls contain lignin, cellulose and hemicellulose

rows: Cell ki asal cell wall
Kuch plant cells mein pukhtagi (maturation) ke baad banti hai
Middle lamella ke andar phailti hai
Protoplast aur primary wall ke darmiyan banti hai
Cellulose, hemicellulose aur pectin, saath proteins
Lignin, cellulose aur hemicellulose
Kam sakht
Lignin ki wajah se zyada sakht

blocks.prompt:
18 What are plasmodesmata? How are they formed?
(Plasmodesmata kya hain? Yeh kaise bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Plasmodesmata chhoti naliyan hain jo saath wale plant cells ke cytoplasm ko seedha jorti hain aur primary aur secondary dono walls ke aar paar jaati hain; in se kuch molecules aik cell se doosre mein jaate hain. Yeh cell division ke dauran bante hain jab parent cell ke ER ke hisse nayi wall mein phans jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: These are small channels that directly connect the cytoplasm of neighbouring plant cells

blocks.prompt:
19 Why do diatoms have higher growth rates?
(Diatoms ki growth zyada tez kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Diatoms apni cell wall silicic acid se banate hain jo cell ke andar polymer ban kar bahar wall ki shakal mein nikalta hai. Silica ki wall banane mein kam energy lagti hai, is liye diatoms tez barhte hain.

book_ref.quote: That is why there are higher growth rates in diatoms

blocks.prompt:
20 Write any four functions of the cell wall.
(Cell wall ke koi chaar kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cell wall (1) sakhti de kar structural aur mechanical sahara deti hai, (2) cell ki shakal aur growth ki simt qaim rakhti hai, (3) paani aane par cell ko had se zyada phoolne se rokti hai, aur (4) jaraseem (pathogens) aur mahol se bachati hai. Yeh carbohydrates ka zakheera bhi hai.

book_ref.quote: Cell walls protect against pathogens and the environment

blocks.prompt:
21 What is the fluid mosaic model? Who proposed it?
(Fluid mosaic model kya hai? Yeh kis ne pesh kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh plasma membrane ki badalti (dynamic) fitrat ka maana hua tasawwur hai: bunyad phospholipids ki lipid bilayer hai jis mein proteins tairte hain. Ise S.J. Singer aur Garth Nicolson ne 1972 mein pesh kiya.

book_ref.quote: The fluid mosaic model is a widely accepted concept that describes the dynamic nature of plasma membrane

blocks.prompt:
22 Why does the plasma membrane need proteins in addition to phospholipids?
(Plasma membrane ko phospholipids ke ilawa proteins ki zaroorat kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lipid bilayer ka andar hydrophobic hai aur paani mein hal hone wale molecules ko rokta hai. Agar cell sirf lipid bilayer mein band ho to sugars aur polar amino acids jaise molecules bilkul na guzar saken, is liye membrane mein raasta dene wale proteins hote hain.

book_ref.quote: If a cell was fully encased in pure lipid bilayer

blocks.prompt:
23 What is the role of cholesterol in the plasma membrane of eukaryotes?
(Eukaryotes ki plasma membrane mein cholesterol ka kya kirdaar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cholesterol molecules phospholipid bilayer ke beech phanse hote hain aur kam temperature par membrane ki fluidity (rawani) qaim rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: plasma membranes have cholesterol molecules, wedged into the phospholipid bilayer

blocks.prompt:
24 Differentiate between a glycoprotein and a glycolipid.
(Glycoprotein aur glycolipid mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono plasma membrane ki bahar ki satah par hote hain:

book_ref.quote: A protein with attached sugar is called a glycoprotein

rows: Protein jis se sugar juri ho
Lipid jis se sugar juri ho
Glycocalyx ka hissa; cell ki pehchaan ka nishan
Glycocalyx ka hissa; cell ki pehchaan ka nishan

blocks.prompt:
25 What is Fluorescence Recovery After Photobleaching (FRAP)? What does it study?
(Fluorescence Recovery After Photobleaching (FRAP) kya hai? Is se kis cheez ka mutaala hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: FRAP membrane proteins aur lipids ki harkat ka mutaala karta hai. Membrane ke fluorescent hisse ko laser se bleach kiya jata hai aur dekha jata hai ke bleach na hue molecules aa kar kaise fluorescence wapas laate hain.

book_ref.quote: It involves bleaching a fluorescently labelled region of the membrane with a laser

blocks.prompt:
26 Name any two microscopic techniques used to study the plasma membrane and state what each shows.
(Plasma membrane ke mutaale ki koi do microscopic techniques ke naam aur un ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Transmission Electron Microscopy lipid bilayer aur proteins ki tafseeli structure dikhati hai. Atomic Force Microscopy membrane ki satah ki unchi resolution wali tasveerein deti hai. (Doosri: SEM satah ke liye, confocal microscopy laser aur fluorescence se.)

book_ref.quote: Atomic Force Microscopy provides topographical images of cell membrane at high resolution

blocks.prompt:
27 What is cytoplasm? Where is it present in eukaryotic and prokaryotic cells?
(Cytoplasm kya hai? Eukaryotic aur prokaryotic cells mein yeh kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cytoplasm neem gaarha aur neem shaffaf maadda hai. Eukaryotic cells mein yeh plasma membrane aur nuclear envelope ke darmiyan, aur prokaryotic cells mein plasma membrane ke neeche saari jagah mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The cytoplasm is a semi-viscous and semi-transparent substance

blocks.prompt:
28 What is cytosol? State one function of the cytoplasm.
(Cytosol kya hai? Cytoplasm ka aik kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cytosol cytoplasm ka paani wala bunyadi maadda hai jis mein organic (proteins, carbohydrates, lipids) aur inorganic namak poore ya kuch had tak hal hote hain. Cytoplasm glycolysis jaisi metabolic reactions ki jagah hai.

book_ref.quote: Cytosol contains water in which many organic

blocks.prompt:
29 State the two major functions of the nucleus.
(Nucleus ke do bare kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Nucleus cell ka maloomati aur intezami markaz hai. Yeh (1) cell ka mauroosi maadda (DNA) mehfooz rakhta hai aur (2) cell ke kaamon, maslan growth, protein synthesis aur cell division, ko munazzam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It serves as information processing and administrative centre of the cell

blocks.prompt:
30 What is the nuclear lamina? What is the perinuclear space?
(Nuclear lamina kya hai? Perinuclear space kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nuclear lamina nuclear envelope ke andar ki taraf protein ki tah hai jo chromatin se jur kar use sahara deti hai. Perinuclear space nuclear envelope ki do tahon ke beech ki jagah hai jo rough ER se juri hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: It binds to chromatin to give it structural support

blocks.prompt:
31 What is the nucleolus? Where is it formed?
(Nucleolus kya hai? Yeh kahan banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleolus nucleoplasm mein aik numayan gehra rangeen dhaancha hai (aik ya do) jo ribosomal subunits banata hai. Yeh chromosomes ke Nucleolus Organizer Regions (NORs) par banta hai jin ka DNA rRNA ka code rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Nucleoli manufacture the subunits that combine to form ribosomes

blocks.prompt:
32 Differentiate between the granular and fibrillar components of the nucleolus.
(Nucleolus ke granular aur fibrillar hisson mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Nucleolus granular aur fibrillar hisson aur DNA par mushtamil hai:

book_ref.quote: The granules consist of ribosomal subunits that have already been formed

rows: Pehle se bane hue ribosomal subunits
Ribosomal subunits ka kacha maal
Tayyar maal
rRNA molecules aur un ke proteins

blocks.prompt:
33 Differentiate between euchromatin and heterochromatin.
(Euchromatin aur heterochromatin mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Chromatin ki do qismein:

book_ref.quote: The other kind of chromatin is termed heterochromatin

rows: Genetically active chromatin
Is ka DNA genetically inactive hai
RNA bana kar proteins banane mein hissa leta hai
Transcription mein hissa nahi leta

blocks.prompt:
34 What is a nucleosome?
(Nucleosome kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chromatin moti jaise daanon ke silsile se bana hai jinhein nucleosomes kehte hain. Nucleosome mein DNA ka dhaaga histones naami chhote proteins ke guchhon ke gird lipta hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The structure of chromatin reveals that it is made of a series of bead-like structures

blocks.prompt:
35 "The number of chromosomes does not correlate with the complexity of an organism." Support this statement with examples.
("Chromosomes ki tadaad jandaar ki pechidgi se mutaliq nahi." Misalon se is baat ki himayat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Insani diploid cells mein 46 chromosomes hain, kuch cheentiyon aur roundworms mein sirf 2, jab ke Indian fern Ophioglossum reticulatum mein 1,260. Fern insaan se zyada pechida nahi, is liye chromosome number species ka khaas hai, pechidgi ka paimana nahi.

book_ref.quote: the number of chromosomes in a species does not correlate to the complexity of the organism

blocks.prompt:
36 How does chromatin differ in appearance during interphase and during cell division?
(Interphase aur cell division ke dauran chromatin ki shakal mein kya farq hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono marhalon mein chromatin ki shakal:

book_ref.quote: the chromatin is dispersed throughout the nucleus in the form of a tangle of fibres

rows: Chromatin poore nucleus mein phaila hota hai
Tamam chromatin dhaage simat jaate hain
Dhaagon ke uljhe guchhe jaisa
Chromosomes bante hain: chromatids aur centromere

blocks.prompt:
37 What are cisternae and the cisternal space of the ER?
(ER ke cisternae aur cisternal space kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cisternae ER ke chapte thaile aur shaakhdaar naliyan hain. Sab cisternae jure hote hain, is liye ER ki aik bari pechdaar lumen hoti hai jise cisternal space kehte hain; yeh cell ke hajam ka 10 percent se zyada hai.

book_ref.quote: These sacs and tubules are called cisternae (singular cisterna)

blocks.prompt:
38 Why is the ER called a pipeline between the nucleus and the cytoplasm?
(ER ko nucleus aur cytoplasm ke darmiyan pipeline kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: ER ke cisternae nuclear envelope ki do tahon se jure hain; ER ki lumen aur perinuclear space aik hi khaana bante hain. Is liye ER ke zariye nucleus aur cytoplasm ke darmiyan cheezein aur maloomat aasani se aati jaati hain.

book_ref.quote: So, the ER provides a pipeline between nucleus and cytoplasm

blocks.prompt:
39 Write the role of smooth ER in (i) liver cells and (ii) muscle cells.
(Smooth ER ka kirdaar likhein: liver cells mein aur muscle cells mein.)
blocks.explanation: Liver cells mein smooth ER zyada hota hai aur dawaon aur zehar ka detoxification (be-asar karna) karta hai. Muscle cells mein smooth ER calcium jama karta hai aur use kharij kar ke muscle contraction shuru karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Smooth endoplasmic reticulum also plays a role in various cellular activities by storing calcium

blocks.prompt:
40 Why does rough ER look bumpy? What does it do with the proteins it makes?
(Rough ER khurdura kyun nazar aata hai? Yeh apne banaye proteins ke saath kya karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ki satah ribosomes se dhaki hoti hai jo use khurdura banate hain. RER proteins banata aur un mein sugars jaise chemicals mila kar process karta hai, phir unhein zaroorat ki jagah ya Golgi apparatus ko bhejta hai.

book_ref.quote: giving it a bumpy appearance when viewed through the microscope

blocks.prompt:
41 What is a Svedberg (S) value? Why are Svedberg values not additive?
(Svedberg (S) value kya hai? Svedberg values jama kyun nahi hotin?)
blocks.explanation: Svedberg value centrifuge mein tah mein baithne (sedimentation) ki raftaar par mabni hai (maslan eukaryotic 40S aur 60S mil kar 80S ribosome). Yeh jama nahi hotin kyun ke sedimentation size aur shakal par munhasir hai, sirf molecular weight par nahi.

book_ref.quote: which are based upon their rate of sedimentation in a centrifuge

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: 40 + 60 = 100 hota hai, magar poora ribosome 80S hai. Wajah: S value wazan nahi, balke tah mein baithne ki raftaar hai, jo shakal par bhi munhasir hai.

blocks.prompt:
42 Differentiate between free ribosomes and ribosomes bound to the RER.
(Azad ribosomes aur RER se jure ribosomes mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Eukaryotic cells mein:

book_ref.quote: While the proteins produced by the ribosomes bound to RER are transported outside of the cell

rows: Cytoplasm mein bikhre hue
Rough ER se chipke hue
Proteins cell ke apne istemal ke liye
Proteins cell se bahar bheje jaate hain

blocks.prompt:
43 Write the roles of mRNA and tRNA in protein synthesis.
(Protein synthesis mein mRNA aur tRNA ka kirdaar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Messenger RNA (mRNA) DNA se li hui hidayat deta hai. Transfer RNA (tRNA) amino acids ko ribosome tak laata hai. Amino acids ki zanjeer mukammal hone par ribosome use chhor deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Messenger RNA (mRNA) provides the instructions, which it has taken from the DNA

blocks.prompt:
44 What are cristae and F-1 particles?
(Cristae aur F-1 particles kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cristae mitochondria ki andar wali pechdaar membrane ki tahein hain jo satah barhati hain. F-1 particles cristae ki andar ki satah se matrix ki taraf knob jaise ubhaar hain; yeh ATP-synthase enzyme hain.

book_ref.quote: The inner surface of the cristae has knob-like extensions into the matrix

blocks.prompt:
45 Why are mitochondria called the power generators of the cell?
(Mitochondria ko cell ke power generators kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mitochondria cellular respiration ki jagah hain. Yeh oxygen aur ghiza se ATP banate hain jo cell ki energy currency hai; matrix ke enzymes Krebs cycle jaise qadam chalate hain aur electron transport chain andar wali membrane par hai.

book_ref.quote: Mitochondria are the sites of cellular respiration

blocks.prompt:
46 What do scientists hypothesize about the origin of mitochondria?
(Mitochondria ki ibtida ke baare mein scientists ka kya khayal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lakhon saal pehle chhote azad prokaryotes ko bare prokaryotes ne nigal liya magar hazm nahi kiya. Dono mein symbiotic (bahami faide ka) rishta bana: bara chhote ko ghiza deta aur chhota bare ko ATP deta.

book_ref.quote: small, free-living prokaryotes were engulfed, but not consumed, by larger prokaryotes

blocks.prompt:
47 What are thylakoids, grana and lamellae?
(Thylakoids, grana aur lamellae kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Thylakoid do saath wali andar ki membranes ke kinaron se jurne se bana disk jaisa khaana hai. Thylakoids ke dher grana (wahid granum) hain. Lamellae baghair hare rang ke hisse hain jo do grana ko jorte hain.

book_ref.quote: two adjacent membranes form a disk-shaped compartment called thylakoid

blocks.prompt:
48 Differentiate between chromoplasts and leucoplasts.
(Chromoplasts aur leucoplasts mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono paudon aur kayi protists ke plastids hain:

book_ref.quote: yellow-to-red coloured chromoplasts give colours to plant parts

rows: Peele se laal rang ke
Be-rang
Paudon ke hisson ko rang dete hain
Cheezein jama karte hain

blocks.prompt:
49 What happens in the thylakoids and in the stroma of a chloroplast?
(Chloroplast ke thylakoids aur stroma mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thylakoids mein chlorophyll light jazb kar ke electrons chhorta hai aur ATP bante hain. Stroma mein inhi ATPs se kam energy wali carbon dioxide ko glucose jaisi zyada energy wali cheez mein badla jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Using these ATPs, in the stroma, low-energy carbon dioxide is transformed

blocks.prompt:
50 Differentiate between the cis face and the trans face of the Golgi apparatus.
(Golgi apparatus ke cis aur trans rukh mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Har Golgi stack ke do alag rukh hain:

book_ref.quote: is positioned near the plasma membrane

rows: Endoplasmic reticulum ke qareeb
Plasma membrane ke qareeb
ER ke vesicles yahan aa kar jurte hain
Tayyar maal yahan se vesicles mein aage jata hai

blocks.prompt:
51 Why did many scientists doubt Golgi's discovery? How was it confirmed?
(Bohat se scientists ne Golgi ki daryaft par shak kyun kiya? Is ki tasdeeq kaise hui?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se scientists ne kaha ke Golgi ka dekha hua dhaancha (1898) asal organelle nahi balke staining ki wajah se nazar ka dhoka hai. Beeswin sadi mein electron microscope ki ijaad ne aakhir saabit kiya ke Golgi apparatus aik organelle hai.

book_ref.quote: The invention of the electron microscope in the twentieth century finally confirmed

blocks.prompt:
52 What are secretions? What does the Golgi apparatus produce in plant cells?
(Secretions kya hain? Plant cells mein Golgi apparatus kya banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Secretions woh maal hai jo Golgi ke trans rukh se vesicles mein cell se bahar bheja jata hai. Plant cells mein Golgi apparatus pectin aur doosre polysaccharides bhi banata hai jo paude ki structure aur metabolism ke liye zaroori hain.

book_ref.quote: The exported products are known as secretions

blocks.prompt:
53 Why does a cell remain uninjured even if a lysosome ruptures inside it?
(Agar cell ke andar lysosome phat jaye to bhi cell ko nuqsan kyun nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Lysosome ke enzymes ko tezabi mahol (pH taqreeban 4.8) chahiye. Lysosome ka andar tezabi hai magar cytosol neutral hai, is liye bahar aaye enzymes inactive ho jaate hain aur cell bacha rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: The cell is safe from the enzymes of lysosomes

blocks.prompt:
54 What are lysosomal storage diseases? Give one example.
(Lysosomal storage diseases kya hain? Aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: In bimariyon mein lysosome ka koi hydrolytic enzyme nahi hota, is liye lysosome na hazm hone wali cheezon se bhar jata hai jo cell ke kaam mein rukawat dalti hain. Misaal: Pompe's disease mein glycogen hazm karne wala enzyme nahi hota aur liver cells mein glycogen jama hota hai.

book_ref.quote: In lysosomal storage diseases, the patient lacks one of the hydrolytic enzymes of lysosome

blocks.prompt:
55 How do lysosomes take part in the development of multicellular organisms?
(Multicellular jandaaron ki development mein lysosomes kaise hissa lete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Lysosomes poore cells khatam karte hain (chuni hui cell death). Maslan tadpole ke maindak banne par us ki dum ke cells lysosome ke enzymes se khatam hote hain; development mein dimagh ke kayi cells bhi lysosome phatne se marte hain.

book_ref.quote: Selective cell death is a mechanism used by multicellular organisms in their development

blocks.prompt:
56 What is the function of catalase in peroxisomes? Write the reaction.
(Peroxisomes mein catalase ka kya kaam hai? Reaction likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Catalase hydrogen peroxide ko, jo cell ke metabolism ki aam zimni paidawar hai, paani aur oxygen mein torta hai:
2H₂O₂ → 2H₂O + O₂ (catalase)

book_ref.quote: Some peroxisomes contain catalase enzymes

blocks.prompt:
57 What is Zellweger syndrome?
(Zellweger syndrome kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zellweger syndrome peroxisomes ki sab se sangeen bimari hai jis mein cells mein peroxisomes nahi hote ya kam hote hain. Yeh paidaishi hai, is ka koi ilaaj nahi aur aksar zindagi ke pehle saal mein maut ho jaati hai.

book_ref.quote: It is congenital disorder (present at birth) and has no cure or effective treatment

blocks.prompt:
58 What is the role of glyoxysomes in germinating seeds?
(Ugte hue beejon mein glyoxysomes ka kya kirdaar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glyoxysomes sirf plant cells mein hain aur in mein lipids ko carbohydrates banane wale enzymes hain. Castor beans aur soyabeans jaise chikanai wale beejon mein yeh jama lipids ko carbohydrates bana kar germination ke liye energy dete hain.

book_ref.quote: During germination, these organelles convert stored lipids into carbohydrates

blocks.prompt:
59 What are tonoplast and cell sap?
(Tonoplast aur cell sap kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tonoplast woh membrane hai jo plant cell ke central vacuole ko gherti hai. Cell sap vacuole ke andar ka maadda hai jo ird gird ke cytoplasm se kaafi mukhtalif hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The material inside the vacuole is called cell sap

blocks.prompt:
60 How does the central vacuole give structural support to a plant?
(Central vacuole paude ko structural sahara kaise deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab paude ko kaafi paani milta hai to central vacuoles us se phool jaate hain. Is se turgor pressure barhta hai jo cell ko sakht banata hai aur cell wall ke saath mil kar paude ka dhaancha qaim rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: It creates a high turgor pressure, which helps maintain the structural integrity of the plant

blocks.prompt:
61 State two roles of plant vacuoles other than support.
(Sahara dene ke ilawa plant vacuoles ke do kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Vacuoles rang (pigments) jama karte hain jo phoolon ko rang de kar shehad ki makhiyon aur doosre pollinators ko khenchte hain. (2) Yeh keeron aur janwaron ke liye zehreele molecules chhorte hain taa ke woh paude ko na khayen.

book_ref.quote: Vacuoles also release molecules that are poisonous to various insects and animals

blocks.prompt:
62 What is a basal body? How does its structure differ from the axoneme?
(Basal body kya hai? Is ki structure axoneme se kaise mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: Basal body woh centriole hai jo har cilium aur flagellum ko jamata hai aur us ka organising markaz hai. Is ka bahar ka ring axoneme jaisa hai magar nau sets mein har aik mein doublet ki jagah teen microtubules (triplet) hain.

book_ref.quote: Each cilium and flagellum is anchored by a centriole, known as basal body

blocks.prompt:
63 What is meant by the "9 + 2" structure of cilia and flagella?
(Cilia aur flagella ki "9 + 2" structure se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Eukaryotic cilia aur flagella ke markaz (axoneme) mein do darmiyani microtubules hain jin ke gird nau doublet microtubules ka ring hai aur dynein saath wale doublets ko jorta hai. Isi tarteeb ko "9 + 2" kehte hain; is ke gird plasma membrane hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: It contains two central microtubules that are surrounded by an outer ring of nine doublet microtubules

blocks.prompt:
64 Differentiate between cilia and flagella.
(Cilia aur flagella mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono patle, dum jaise harkat ke aazaa hain:

book_ref.quote: Cilia are short in length and are usually numerous in number

blocks.prompt:
65 Differentiate between microfilaments and microtubules.
(Microfilaments aur microtubules mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono cytoskeleton ke fibres hain:

book_ref.quote: These are present in all eukaryotic cells

Shakal dena, organelles ke raaste, cilia, flagella aur spindle fibres banana

blocks.prompt:
66 What are intermediate filaments? Write their function.
(Intermediate filaments kya hain? In ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Intermediate filaments cytoskeleton ke fibres hain jo sirf kuch unche janwaron mein hain aur mukhtalif proteins se bane hain (aam tor par vimentin; jild mein keratin). Yeh cell ki shakal aur sakhti qaim rakhte hain aur nucleus samait organelles ko jamate hain.

book_ref.quote: Intermediate filaments maintain cell shape and rigidity

blocks.prompt:
67 What is a nucleoid?
(Nucleoid kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Prokaryotic cell mein nucleus nahi hota. Is ka kam DNA aik darmiyani hisse mein hota hai jise nucleoid (nucleus jaisa) kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: A prokaryotic cell lacks a nucleus

blocks.prompt:
68 What are the capsule and pili of bacteria?
(Bacteria ka capsule aur pili kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bacteria mein cell wall ke gird capsule ho sakta hai. Bacteria mein chipakne ke liye bahar nikle hisse bhi hote hain jinhein pili (wahid pilus; kitaab mein "pillus" ghalat chhapa hai) kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: In bacteria the cell wall may also be surrounded by a capsule

blocks.prompt:

(Prokaryotic aur eukaryotic cells ke ribosomes mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ribosomes dono mein hain, magar:

(Prokaryotic aur eukaryotic flagella mein farq likhein.)

blocks.prompt:
71 Name three features that are common to prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells.
(Prokaryotic aur eukaryotic cells ki teen mushtarka khususiyat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein (1) DNA genetic maadda hai, (2) plasma membrane ghilaaf hai aur (3) protein banane ke liye ribosomes hain.

book_ref.quote: Both prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells have DNA as their genetic material

blocks.prompt:
72 Define cell signalling. Name its three steps.
(Cell signalling ki definition likhein aur is ke teen qadam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Cell signalling cells ki mahol ke stimuli ka jawab dene ki salahiyat hai jo molecular waqiyat ke silsile se hoti hai. Is ke qadam: (1) signal reception, (2) signal transduction, (3) cellular response.

book_ref.quote: It involves the transmission of signals between cells through a series of molecular events

blocks.prompt:
73 What is a ligand? Where are its receptors located?
(Ligand kya hai? Is ke receptors kahan hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ligand woh signal molecule hai jo target cell ke receptor se jur kar signalling shuru karta hai. Receptors aam tor par membrane mein jure proteins hote hain magar cell ke andar bhi ho sakte hain; har receptor kisi khaas ligand ke liye hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Each receptor is specific to a particular ligand

blocks.prompt:
74 What are second messengers? Give two examples.
(Second messengers kya hain? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Second messengers chhote molecules hain jo signal transduction mein signal ko receptor se cell ke andar ke target molecules tak le jaate hain. Misalein: cAMP (cyclic AMP), calcium ions aur inositol triphosphate (IP₃).

book_ref.quote: transmitting the signal from the receptor to target molecules inside the cell

blocks.prompt:
75 Why do steroid hormones enter the target cell, while protein hormones bind at its surface?
(Steroid hormones target cell ke andar kyun chale jaate hain jab ke protein hormones satah par hi jurte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Steroid hormones chikanai pasand (lipophilic) hain, is liye membrane se diffuse ho kar cytoplasm ya nucleus ke receptors se jurte hain. Protein ya peptide signals paani mein hal hote hain aur membrane se nahi guzar sakte, is liye satah ke receptors se jurte hain.

book_ref.quote: When such ligand approaches the cell surface, it binds to its specific receptor on plasma membrane

blocks.prompt:
76 Give any four cellular responses that may result from cell signalling.
(Cell signalling ke nateeje mein hone wale koi chaar cellular jawab likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Signalling genes ko on ya off kar ke cell growth, division, differentiation ya apoptosis (programmed cell death) la sakti hai. Yeh metabolism, enzyme activity ya ion channels ke khulne band hone ko bhi badal sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: The signal transduction pathway often leads to changes in gene expression

blocks.prompt:
77 Why are membrane transport mechanisms essential for a cell?
(Cell ke liye membrane transport ke tareeqe kyun zaroori hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh cell ko homeostasis qaim rakhne, ghiza lene, fuzla nikalne aur mahol se raabta rakhne ke qaabil banate hain (ghiza lena, fuzla nikalna, gas ka tabadla aur signal transduction).

book_ref.quote: Membrane transport mechanisms are essential processes that enable the cell to maintain homeostasis

blocks.prompt:
78 Define active transport. Give one example.
(Active transport ki definition likhein. Aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Active transport plasma membrane ke aar paar maaddon ki kam concentration se zyada concentration ki taraf energy laga kar harkat hai. Misaal: nerve cells ka sodium-potassium pump jo ATP laga kar Na⁺ bahar aur K⁺ andar le jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The movement of substances across plasma membrane from lower concentration to higher concentration

blocks.prompt:
79 What is receptor-mediated endocytosis? Give an example.
(Receptor-mediated endocytosis kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Receptor-mediated endocytosis mein plasma membrane ke khaas receptor proteins bahar se cheez pakar kar andar ki taraf daba kar vesicle banate hain. Misaal: liver cells ke cholesterol receptors khoon se LDLs isi tarah lete hain.

book_ref.quote: Specific receptor proteins of plasma membrane pick up material from outside

blocks.prompt:

(Channel proteins aur carrier proteins mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono facilitated diffusion ke transport proteins hain:

book_ref.quote: These proteins form hydrophilic channels across the membrane

blocks.explanation: Dono passive hain aur zyada se kam concentration ki taraf le jaate hain, magar:

book_ref.quote: Primarily involves polar or charged molecules, such as glucose, amino acids, and ions

blocks.prompt:
82 Define osmosis. Why is it a passive process?
(Osmosis ki definition likhein. Yeh passive amal kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Osmosis paani ke molecules ka selectively permeable membrane ke aar paar zyada (paani ki) concentration se kam ki taraf diffusion hai, yani hypotonic se hypertonic mahlool ki taraf. Paani apne gradient ke saath chalta hai, energy nahi lagti, is liye yeh passive hai.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, osmosis is the passive transport of water

blocks.prompt:
83 What is tonicity? Define hypertonic and hypotonic solutions.
(Tonicity kya hai? Hypertonic aur hypotonic mahlool ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Tonicity mahloolon mein solutes ka nisbati concentration hai. Hypertonic mahlool mein solute zyada aur hypotonic mein kam hota hai (isotonic mein barabar).

book_ref.quote: The term tonicity refers to the relative concentration of solutes in the solutions

blocks.prompt:
84 What is reverse osmosis? Where is it used?
(Reverse osmosis kya hai? Yeh kahan istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reverse osmosis mein bairooni dabao se paani ko semi-permeable membrane ke zariye zyada solute se kam solute ki taraf dhakela jata hai aur ghule namak aur gandagi nikal jaati hai. Yeh water treatment plants, samandari paani saaf karne (desalination) aur gharelu filters mein istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It is a widely used technology for purifying water by removing contaminants and impurities

blocks.prompt:
85 What are aquaporins? What is their importance?
(Aquaporins kya hain? In ki ahmiyat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aquaporins khaas channel proteins hain jo paani ke molecules ko cell membrane se tezi se guzaarte hain aur cell mein paani ki miqdaar aur hajam ko achhi tarah control karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Specialized proteins called aquaporins facilitate the rapid transport of water molecules across the cell membrane

blocks.prompt:
86 What happens to the new cells when a stem cell divides?
(Jab stem cell taqseem hota hai to naye cells ke saath kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har naya cell ya to stem cell hi reh sakta hai ya khaas cell ban sakta hai, maslan muscle cell, red blood cell ya dimagh ka cell.

book_ref.quote: When a stem cell divides, each new cell has the potential either to remain a stem cell

blocks.prompt:

(Totipotent aur pluripotent stem cells mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Banaye jaane wale cell types ki tadaad ke lehaaz se:

book_ref.quote: These cells can turn into almost any cell

blocks.prompt:
88 Differentiate between multipotent and unipotent stem cells.
(Multipotent aur unipotent stem cells mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Banaye jaane wale cell types ki tadaad ke lehaaz se:

book_ref.quote: These can only produce cells of one kind, which is their own type

blocks.prompt:
89 What are the concerns of using embryonic stem cells?
(Embryonic stem cells ke istemal mein kya khadshaat hain?)
blocks.explanation: Khadshaat: insani embryos ka istemal (akhlaqi masla), teratoma (rasoli) banne ka khatra aur mumkin immune rejection (jism ka qubool na karna).

book_ref.quote: Ethical concerns of using ESCs include the use of human embryos

blocks.explanation: Asal ke lehaaz se qismein:

book_ref.quote: They have high differentiation potential, making them extremely versatile for research and therapy

blocks.prompt:
91 What are induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs)? How are they made?
(Induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) kya hain? Yeh kaise banaye jaate hain?)
blocks.explanation: iPSCs embryonic stem cells jaise pluripotent stem cells hain jo lab mein adult somatic cells ko khaas transcription factors se reprogram kar ke banaye jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: They are generated in the lab by reprogramming adult somatic cells

blocks.prompt:
92 How are stem cells useful in personalized medicine?
(Personalized medicine mein stem cells kaise mufeed hain?)
blocks.explanation: Stem cells mareez ke apne cells se banaye ja sakte hain, is liye ilaaj mein immune rejection ka khatra kam hota hai. Yeh zaati tareeqa zyada mufeed aur mehfooz ilaaj deta hai.

book_ref.quote: This personalized approach can lead to more effective and safer therapies
